plain.li: {LOST} was standing at the back of the crowd in my dream, as if they'd come to their own day, and kept quiet so as not to spoil it.
{LOST} came in the dream and asked what we'd said about them. I told them. They laughed at the parts we got wrong.
We were all at the grave again, and {LOST} was the one saying the words.

warm.li: {LOST} came the night after we remembered them, just to say thank you.

blunt.li: Dreamt of {LOST} after the remembrance. Expected it.

gloomy.li: We remember {LOST} once a year. In the dream, {LOST} asked why only once.

cold.li: A dream of {LOST}, following the remembrance. The mind keeps its own calendar.

plain.li: The feast went on all night, and every time a plate emptied someone I loved filled it again.
Dreamt the cooks kept bringing out dishes I'd never seen, and each one tasted like a different year.
In the dream we kept the day again, and then again, and nobody minded.

warm.li: Dreamt of the table, full, and every chair taken, even the ones we keep empty.

cheerful.li: The feast in my dream had seven kinds of pie. I'm going to mention this to the cook.

cold.li: A pleasant dream about the colony's day. The seating was sensible.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of what was taken

plain.li: Went back to what the council gave me, in the dream, and the door opened onto an empty field.
The council handed me a gift, wrapped, and every time I unwrapped it there was another wrapping inside.
Dreamt I was at the meeting asking for it back, and nobody could hear me over the vote.

blunt.li: Dreamt about what they took back. Not surprised.

gloomy.li: Dreamt they gave it to me again, just to take it away again. Felt very real.

cold.li: A dream about the broken promise. I am apparently not over it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of building it again

plain.li: Building it again in my dream, and every time I set the last piece the first one fell.
The fields came up green and turned black the moment I looked away.
Carrying the pieces home in my arms, and there were always more than I could hold.

blunt.li: Dreamt it fell down again. Tired before I've started.

cheerful.li: Dreamt it fell down again, but in the dream I'd built it out of bread, so at least there was breakfast.

gloomy.li: Built it again in my sleep. Lost it again in my sleep.

cold.li: Rebuilt it in the dream, piece by piece. A waste of effort, twice over.

plain.li: Dreamt I was up on the roof fixing it, and nothing hurt, and nobody told me to come down.
In the dream I was well again and carrying everyone else's loads for them, for once.
Dreamt of the people who sat by my bed, all of them in one room, talking about anything but me.

warm.li: The ones who sat with me while I was ill were all asleep in my dream, and I was the one keeping watch.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I climbed the tallest thing in the colony without stopping for breath. Next week, maybe.
